findings.title: Transient review-admission gap after pause begins
findings.detail: A stale unpaused publisher can pass its version check before pause increments the fence/version, then publish unpaused while pause is pending; a new review is admitted before the final paused publication.

findings.title: publication_lock and CW11 lock deadlock
findings.detail: Publisher holds publication_lock while waiting for the CW11 lock; an admit callback can hold the CW11 lock and reach status/cancellation synchronization that waits for publication_lock.

findings.title: Late post-probe peer replacement resumes stale binding
findings.detail: Manager can switch during the subsequent worker probe; local-only final checks release the fence with an old bound manager identity and a replacement actual peer.
